name: Group Work Day
description: Teams pick jobs, then check off a shared to-do list while the projector shows every group's live progress. For lab days, station rotations, project work: any 'here is what your group must finish today'. No points, no winners: completion tracking with a job for everyone.
tagline: Perfect for labs, stations, and project sessions where every group works the same task list and everyone has a job.

groupSize.label: Students per group
groupSize.helper: Groups of this size. A class that does not divide evenly gets a few groups one smaller; nobody works alone.

method.label: How groups form
method.helper: Pick one; the line under it says what happens.

valueHelp.random: Instant: the room deals the groups when you press Start, no choosing.
valueHelp.choice: Students tap the group they want to join, first come first served, each group filling to the size above.
valueHelp.teacher: You arrange the names into groups on the projector before the work starts.

roles.label: The jobs, one per line
roles.helper: One job per group member, up to 8. A group bigger than the list repeats jobs. Leave the list empty for no jobs.

roleMethod.label: How jobs are given
roleMethod.helper: Pick one; the line under it says what happens.

valueHelp.choice: Students claim a job inside their group, one each; a job a group-mate took is greyed out, and anyone who has not picked when you close the step gets what is left.
valueHelp.random: The room hands out the jobs when the step opens, no picking.

default: Introduce yourselves and agree on a team name
Facilitator: make sure everyone has said their name and one interest
Find three things everyone in your group has in common (going to this school doesn't count)
Recorder: write your group's three common things where everyone can see them
Agree on one dream field trip, a destination and the reason
Timekeeper: give a two-minutes-left warning before the pitch planning ends
Plan a 30-second pitch for your field trip and pick who delivers it
Final check: mark this when every member has spoken at least twice
tasks.label: The tasks, one per line
tasks.helper: Every group gets the same list; any member can check a task off and the whole group sees it. Start a line with a job and a colon (Recorder: write it down) and it becomes that job's task, highlighted on that student's screen.

template.name: Group Work Day
template.description: Teams pick jobs, then check off a shared to-do list, live progress on the projector. Built with the Group Work Day recipe.

intro.message:
GROUP WORK DAY!

You're about to be split into groups, and everyone gets a job.

Every group has the same checklist on their devices, check tasks off as your group finishes them, and watch the progress board up here.

worktime.prompt: Work through today's tasks with your group. Tagged tasks belong to a job, but the whole group backs each other up.

end.message: That's Group Work Day! Swap in your own tasks and jobs for any lab, stations, or project session.
